en.headline: Government prices record HK$20 billion digital green bonds
en.dek: The fourth multi-currency digital green bond issuance under the Sustainable Bond Programme was oversubscribed and set a new global record for the largest digital bond offering of its kind.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government on Tuesday announced the successful pricing of around HK$20 billion equivalent of digital green bonds denominated in Hong Kong dollars, renminbi, US dollars and euros under its Sustainable Bond Programme.

The offering, priced on 28 September after a virtual roadshow, comprised a HK$5.5 billion two-year tranche at 3.80 per cent, a RMB7.5 billion five-year tranche at 1.65 per cent, a US$200 million three-year tranche at 5.023 per cent and a EUR450 million four-year tranche at 3.734 per cent. Subscription ratios across the four currencies ranged from about 1.3 times to 11.3 times.

Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the issuance was the largest digital bond offering of its kind globally and demonstrated strong market appetite for tokenised products issued in Hong Kong. The bonds incorporate tokenised deposits for the Hong Kong-dollar tranche, described as a world first in integrating such deposits into a primary digital-bond settlement process.

The government said proceeds would finance or refinance eligible green projects under its Green Bond Framework. The issuance also adopted the International Capital Market Association’s latest Bond Data Taxonomy Version 2.0 to promote data consistency and automation across the bond lifecycle. The Monetary Authority and relevant bureaux said the exercise reinforced Hong Kong’s position in green and digital finance.

zh.headline: 政府成功定價約200億元等值數碼綠色債券 刷新全球紀錄
zh.dek: 特區政府在可持續債券計劃下第四次發行數碼綠色債券，涵蓋港元、人民幣、美元及歐元，規模為全球同類最大，並獲超額認購。
body: 香港特別行政區政府周二宣布，在政府可持續債券計劃下成功定價約200億港元等值的數碼綠色債券，涵蓋港元、人民幣、美元及歐元。
債券於9月28日經網上路演後定價，包括55億港元兩年期債券息率3.80厘、75億人民幣五年期債券息率1.65厘、2億美元三年期債券息率5.023厘，以及4.5億歐元四年期債券息率3.734厘。四個幣種認購額為發行額的約1.3倍至11.3倍。
財政司司長陳茂波表示，是次發行規模為全球同類債券中最大，並獲超額認購，反映市場對香港代幣化產品的投資需求。港元債券首次在一級發行結算過程中納入代幣化存款，屬全球首創。所得資金將用於融資或再融資符合綠色債券框架的合資格項目。
發行亦採用國際資本市場協會最新債券數據分類術語2.0版，促進數據一致性及自動化。金管局及相關政策局表示，是次發行進一步鞏固香港在綠色及數碼金融的地位。
